parent_finding.mechanism: ensure_recording records CmdResetQueryPool in the new command buffer. On a reused slot, a host GetQueryPoolResults call before that queued reset executes may observe the previous completed batch's available timestamp. wait_for_timeline_progress then latches started=1 and disables the 10-second no-progress deadline for a new submission that has not started.
parent_finding.potential_effect: Stall detection delayed until the 30-minute outer deadline
parent_finding.coverage_gap: Reviewer midstream wedge scenario uses a submission without a compute query; it does not establish query-slot reuse safety
parent_finding.requested_check: Complete an initial timestamped batch, reuse its slot, block new batch before its queued reset, and verify no stale availability is accepted as new-generation progress

timestamp_followup.result: Final reused-slot and started-wall controls timed out with exit124; not accepted
